verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party bulk export or 'download all data' feature. Data could still be pulled programmatically: the authenticated REST API covers Clients, Invoices, Payments, Expenses, Bills, Journal Entries and Reports, with an official Node SDK and Postman collection. Leaving with your data is therefore possible only by building your own extraction against the API. Missing for 10: a documented one-click/bulk export of all data, explicit open-format exports (CSV/JSON/accounting-standard files), documentation of account closure or offboarding, and independent hands-on confirmation that a complete export is achievable.
